_note_normalisation: 旧スクリプトにあった Normalization ブロック（CVC評価損の戻し・SaaS営業損失の戻し）は extra_tables の 'Normalization' として保持。分母の売上 9,618 は FY2025/9 実績、7,995 は FY2024/9 実績。
title: Segment Bridge - Fixstars (3687): Solution vs SaaS vs Other (CVC)
intro: Only 2 fiscal years of segment data are disclosed (FY2024/9, FY2025/9) - too few for the main DCF's 4-year hist_years array, hence this separate sheet rather than a 'segments' override block.

Consolidated operating margin (26.8%) understates the Solution segment's profitability (35.3%) because of two below-the-line drags: a SaaS segment still running losses, and a one-off CVC securities writedown sitting in cost of sales.

consolidated.profit_note: Disclosed consolidated operating income. Segment revenue does not sum to consolidated revenue (7,995 / 9,618) because 'Other' revenue is not disclosed separately.

extra_tables.title: Normalization (FY2025/9, JPY mn)
extra_tables.note: Revenue denominators are FY2025/9 actuals (9,618). The CVC writedown is a one-off charge inside cost of sales; the SaaS operating loss is a deliberate investment. Both are live links to the segment block above, not restated constants.

extra_tables.title: Customer Concentration (disclosed 10%+ customers only)
extra_tables.note: Disclosure threshold is 10% of revenue; Renesas fell below 10% in FY2025/9 and became non-disclosed - this does not necessarily mean the relationship ended, only that it dropped below the reporting threshold. Kioxia alone is 17.1% of FY2025/9 revenue and is a NAND-memory cyclical: a memory downcycle transmits directly into Fixstars' Solution-segment revenue via reduced customer R&D spend.

notes: The gap between consolidated margin (26.8%) and Solution-segment margin (35.3%) is the sum of a deliberate investment (SaaS loss) and a one-off charge (CVC writedown), not core-business deterioration.
The investment case reduces to two questions: (a) when does the 424 SaaS operating loss shrink or turn positive, and (b) does the CVC writedown recur. Neither is knowable from FY2025/9 data alone.
This sheet is informational; no cell on the DCF Model sheet references it.
